summary: Prove and replay that every Cayley-Dickson algebra has ker L_a = ker R_a, so a b = 1 forces b a = 1; index the Rocq proof sources in a root formalization.yaml.

reconciliation.note: Opened from the openai/math crosswalk: family 197 refutes direct finiteness in untwisted group algebras of torsion-free groups; the twisted group algebras R^sigma[Z_2^n] of cd_core keep it at every n, which the note proves and the record checks.

scope: The written proof in docs/notes/topics/cd-one-sided-inverses.md, the exact replay scripts/cd_one_sided_inverses.py with its retained record under docs/evidence/cd-one-sided-inverses/ and gate core-record-check-08, and the root formalization.yaml indexing the fourteen Rocq sources. A Rocq proof of the kernel equality and dimensions above 32 stay out of scope.
next_action: None; the plan is closed. A Rocq statement of Lemmas 1 to 3 against CdTowerBasisSign.v is the open follow-up.

steps.action: Write Lemmas 1 to 4, the kernel-equality theorem and the inverse corollary by induction on the doubling, with no use of associativity.
steps.acceptance: Fails if any lemma step uses an identity that the doubling does not preserve, or if a checked element violates the theorem.

receipts.result: Lemmas 1 to 4, the theorem and the corollary are written by induction on the doubling; every checked element of the record satisfies them.

steps.action: Check the basis identities through dimension 128 and the kernel equality with the two-sided inverse law on every signed two-blade, three-unit sum and doubly pure grid element at dimensions 16 and 32; retain the record and gate it.
steps.acceptance: Fails if --check departs from the retained bytes, if pooled and serial runs differ, or if any element raises.

receipts.result: --check reproduces the record pooled (5.7 s) and serial (19.7 s, GOROROBA_WORKERS=1); 0 of 1932 zero divisors violate the kernel equality or the inverse law.

steps.action: Write the root formalization.yaml in the mathlib-initiative v0.4 schema with every exported theorem, its file and its kernel-checked axiom list.
steps.acceptance: Fails if the file does not validate against v0.4.schema.json or names a declaration, file or source that the tree lacks.

receipts.result: formalization.yaml validates against v0.4.schema.json with jsonschema 4.26.0; every declaration, file and source it names exists in the tree.

resolution: The note proves the theorem, gate core-record-check-08 replays the record, and formalization.yaml validates; all three steps carry receipts at the committed revision.

receipts.result: All three steps are done with receipts: the note's proof, the gated record (core-record-check-08) and the validated formalization.yaml.
